doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Forming the band for Dallas in 1929
summary: The band was assembled in New Orleans for Albert's Dallas job in October 1929; the men travelled in three cars, and Jack was taken on for his transportation.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What was it like when you joined the band? Where is it? Were you all alone? Were you all alone? Were you all alone? Were you all alone? playing occasionally on a record, but not big bands apparently. Right. Not that I just like the one I've heard. It is, it is. I just wondered why I looked at it. What was it like when you joined the band? Where?
We all left in the audience together. You all left in the audience? The band was organized in the audience. That's how we left, Julian. And, uh, Don had a job in Dallas at the States.
Mm-hmm. So, they came in, you know, trying to get musicians to go to Dallas for this band. Yeah, but you got stuck in the field.
You didn't tell me you needed no money. Everybody else wanted to know.

He's the only one who didn't ask me for nothing. I didn't let him have nothing. Barbara had wanted $40. Come back just about a day before we were going to leave, wanted $40 more. Well, we couldn't go to North Goldberg, let me have a thousand dollars. And, we bought my thousands right at the end of the road. So, we had three automobiles. We had a model team, which is authored. And, uh, my convertible price. And, uh, Frank Jackie had this convertible Dodge home. And, uh, we left them. We went all the way to Dallas and left transportation like that. Mark's contract was, uh, office buddy and friend. So, he was always with his big fat stuff next to the little office. And, uh, my teeth hole. I'd be afraid it was going to turn up.
He'd run all the way to Dallas. In fact, he got there before he did because it practically broke down entirely. Well, did Jack A live anywhere? Jack was having to know all these things.
I ain't never known him before in my life. You just found him. Yeah, I just found him. I needed transportation.
But, whether he could blow or not, I was going to use him because he had transportation.
